app.name: Dadoverse
app.tagline: A TTRPG dice roller for complex dice systems

landing.title:
Less math.
More story.
landing.description: Roll dice, add bonuses, and manage modifiers in seconds. Invite your friends and rediscover the simplest way to throw dices without math interrupting the flow.

features.headline: Simplicity
features.title: A lightweight tool with heavyweight capabilities.
features.description: Everything you need, from dice physics to multi-system rules—into a single, intuitive interface that lets you focus on the story, not the software.

items.physicsDescription: Integrated dice with realistic physics. Roll, add, and get instant results synced with your entire table in real-time.
items.engineDescription: Native support for Daggerheart, Fabula Ultima, and more in the way. The interface adapts to your favorite game's rules.
items.sessionsDescription: Create a room and share the link. No complicated sign-ups for your players: jumping in and rolling takes only seconds.
items.logDescription: Persistent history of all session rolls. Who rolled, what they got, and the narrative outcome, always in sight.
items.privacyDescription: Your data is yours. We manage security through Supabase and Cloudflare, ensuring your campaigns are always protected.
items.openSourceDescription: Built by and for the community. Dadoverso is an open, transparent tool constantly evolving alongside the players.

cta.title: Ready to roll the dice?
cta.description: The fastest way to manage your rolls in Daggerheart, Year Zero Engine, and more.

duality.title: Daggerheart
duality.description: The Duality Dice system in the Daggerheart RPG uses two d12s (Hope and Fear) rolled together to determine success and narrative tone.

yze.title: Year Zero Engine
yze.description: In the dice pool system, every action is resolved by rolling a bunch of d6 dice; only results of 6 count as successes, and the number of successes determines the outcome of the action.

step.title: Step Dice
step.description: The step-dice variant uses different-sized dice (d6, d8, d10...), giving a gentler difficulty curve and fewer push penalties.

modiphius2d20.title: Modiphius 2D20
modiphius2d20.description: The Modiphius 2D20 system uses two d20 dice to determine the outcome of actions, with the difference between the dice determining the degree of success.
